formula: Sum of zone weight multiplied by (player zone win fraction minus same-season pooled mean) divided by pooled population standard deviation.
baselineGrouping: All qualifying NHL positions pooled; each player equally weighted. Each zone baseline uses its independently eligible pool.
combinedEligibility: Overall minimum and all three zone minimums required. Incomplete profiles receive no partial score or redistributed weights.
contextOnly: Overall, PP, SH and even-strength results receive no extra weight.
missingDataPolicy: Recorded statistics retained. Nonqualifying indices remain blank, distinct from a valid zero. Invalid eligible inputs fail the run.
historicalAggregation: Equal average of unrounded eligible season indices within the configured historical window.
gradeComparisonGroups: Season grades pool eligible indices within each season. Historical grades pool players with at least one eligible season across all NHL positions.
percentileMethod: 100 * (players below + half the players tied) / group size.
ratingMethod: Percentile divided by 10, rounded to one decimal. Unrated and not applicable remain distinct from zero.
note: Provisional descriptive faceoff ratings. Shared percentile grading is used across categories. A rounded 10.0 does not indicate perfection. No overall-value contribution has been assigned.
